mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate is persistently below its long-run average, the discount rate for future cash flows declines, lowering the present value of expected dividends and thereby pushing S&P 500 forward returns positive over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) during the identified low-rate period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly employment (PAYEMS) coinciding with rising consumer confidence (HOUST) predicts stronger labor market conditions, which boost corporate earnings expectations and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >2% month-over-month and HOUST rises by >5% from the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns show no significant correlation with the combined labor proxies (Spearman's rho < 0.2).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its trend suggests weakening supply-side demand, which, when combined with falling consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL), increases the likelihood of a near-term S&P 500 bearish forward return over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite INDPRO remaining below trend for ≥10 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in manufacturing activity (GDPC1) above 10% quarterly growth, without a corresponding increase in unemployment proxies (UNRATE), signals robust supply-side expansion that supports higher equity valuations and positive 5-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 quarterly growth >10% and UNRATE < prev quarter
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative even when GDPC1 growth exceeds 10%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp spike in inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200) followed by a rapid decline in the Fed funds rate (FEDFUNDS) creates a 'tapering' effect that temporarily elevates expected equity risk premia, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses 200 and FEDFUNDS falls by >0.5% in the following month
regime_hint: Inflation spike followed by rate cuts
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite the inflation-rate decline pattern.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in job openings (PAYEMS) accompanied by a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, which can trigger upward equity price pressure over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >10% and UNRATE falls below 4%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns show no significant correlation with the labor proxies (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in retail sales proxy (not available in the catalog; fallback: use HOUST as a demand proxy) with no offsetting rise in industrial production (INDPRO) predicts demand weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decreases for 3 consecutive months and INDPRO remains flat
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite the demand weakening pattern.

mechanism_narrative: When the supply-side index (INDPRO) remains above its long-run mean while consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) is stable, it suggests robust production capacity, which supports higher equity valuations and positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative even when INDPRO is above trend and CPIAUCSL is stable.
